environment.description: Application deployed identically but behind an envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) in an ECS Fargate task. The envoy configuration uses a Lua filter on the listener that applies input normalization: any request where a query parameter value contains characters outside [a-zA-Z0-9@._\-\s] after percent-decoding has those parameters stripped to empty string before forwarding to the upstream app on localhost:8080. Additionally, the task's awsvpc ENI is in a private subnet with no internet-facing ingress — traffic arrives only through an internal NLB whose target group health check path is /health. The NLB is fronted by a CloudFront distribution with a custom origin request policy that sets X-Forwarded-Proto and passes query strings unmodified. CloudFront has a Lambda@Edge viewer-request function (Node.js 18) that enforces a request body/query size limit of 256 bytes total for the query string component and rejects requests exceeding this with 413.

config.compute: ECS Fargate, awsvpc mode, private subnet only
config.sidecar: Envoy 1.28 with Lua HTTP filter: percent-decodes query param values then strips any value containing chars not in [a-zA-Z0-9@._\-\s] to empty string
config.envoy_lua_filter: function envoy_on_request(handle) local qs = handle:headers():get(':path'):match('?(.+)$') or '' for k,v in qs:gmatch('([^&=]+)=([^&]*)') do local decoded = v:gsub('%%(%x%x)', function(h) return string.char(tonumber(h,16)) end) if decoded:find('[^%w@%._%-%s]') then handle:headers():replace(':path', handle:headers():get(':path'):gsub(k..'='..v, k..'=')) end end end
config.network: private subnet, no IGW, ingress only via internal NLB
config.cdn: CloudFront with Lambda@Edge viewer-request enforcing query_string_length <= 256 bytes
